levels.surface: علي بن يحيى بن خلاد بن رافع بن مالك الأنصاري

notes: «عن عم، له بدري» : the uncle is named only by relation, so he is a relation link; «له بدري» describes him and is not part of the surface
«قال حدثني أبي» : Ali's father, a relation with no name
The saying is the uncle's own account (he sat in the mosque with the Prophet), so he is the last link
